$doc: The Blight (enemy faction). hp/shield are Normal difficulty at wave 1; see README 'Formulas' for scaling. speed m/s along the path. armor = share of physical/explosive damage blocked. resist = damage taken multiplier per type (<1 resists, >1 weak). leak = base damage when it reaches the keep. archetype picks behaviour defaults; model.builder names a procedural model.

enemies.name: Husk
enemies.description: Shambling Blight-touched scrap. The backbone of every wave.

enemies.name: Skitter
enemies.description: Six-legged sprinter. Fragile, but hard to catch.

enemies.name: Ironshell
enemies.description: Plated crawler. Bullets glance off; burn, shock or blast it.

enemies.name: Gloomwing
enemies.description: Flies over the road. Only towers that can hit air can touch it.

enemies.name: Mender
enemies.description: Pulses every 2.5 s, healing nearby Blight for 8% of their max health. Kill it first.

enemies.name: Brood Sac
enemies.description: Bursts into four Mites when popped.

enemies.name: Bulwark
enemies.description: Carries a rift shield. Lightning and arcane break shields fastest.

enemies.name: Mossback
enemies.description: Regrows 3% of its max health per second. Burst it down or set it alight.

enemies.name: Mite
enemies.description: Comes in swarms. Splash damage clears them.

enemies.name: Rift Caller
enemies.description: Opens small rifts that spill Mites, and hexes nearby towers (1.5 s stun).
